name: Memory of the Late Mistress (CR 7)
body:
A woman died, choked to death by her jealous lover on this bed, forever tainting it with ghostly malice toward the living.

XP 3,200; CE haunt (a large bed); Caster Level 1st; Notice Perception DC 27 (to hear quiet wheezing and gasping); hp 14; Trigger touch; Reset 1 hour

EFFECT

When this haunt is triggered, invisible ghostly hands choke the first person that touches the bed, acting as suffocation (DC 17).

DESTRUCTION

The love letter from the woman’s lover, hidden somewhere in the bed, must be removed and burned.
